rounded:
Create a final hand-drawn 2D animation spritesheet of Nery Mizuki.
IMAGE 1 is the ONLY authority for character design and BODY PROPORTIONS. Preserve her original cute solid chibi proportions: large head, short compact body, visibly full rounded thighs, plump calves and knees, stout little legs, chunky sneakers. Her legs must have the SAME fullness as image1. She is NOT a thin mannequin, adult fashion figure or articulated doll. Keep copper red hair, amber eyes, cream bows, open charcoal hoodie with terracotta trim, cream shirt, dark shorts, dark socks and warm brown sneakers.
IMAGE 2 is ONLY a guide to the ordered LEG POSITIONS and foot support, NOT a reference for body shape. Its thin legs and stiff puppet appearance were explicitly REJECTED. Do NOT copy its skinny anatomy, angular knees, tiny calves or rigid arm pose.
Redraw all sixteen complete cels in a cohesive hand-animated anime/chibi style based on IMAGE1, facing LEFT in profile. EXACTLY FOUR columns x FOUR rows, chronological reading order. Preserve each corresponding foot position / stance-to-swing sequence from image2, while restoring the original thick rounded chibi legs. Natural continuous integrated knees with no segmented doll joints. Relaxed shoulder/elbow counter-swing, small torso weight shifts, subtle secondary hair/hoodie motion; stable face, head size and ground level throughout. One foot bears weight at every instant, no skating, no repeated single-foot shuffle. Include all contact, down, passing and up poses for BOTH alternating steps. End leads naturally to first contact without duplicating endpoint.
All full figures centered in equal cells at one consistent scale with generous clear margins. Transparent background, clean alpha, no shadows, no labels, no words, no numbers, no guide lines, no floor stripes. This must look like the original Nery herself walking, not a cutout puppet.
articulatedParts:
Production cutout animation asset sheet for Nery Mizuki, matching the attached side-profile character EXACTLY in rendering, face, copper hair, amber eye, cream bow, charcoal open hoodie with terracotta trim, cream shirt, dark shorts, dark socks, brown sneakers with cream soles. Prepare SIX SEPARATE raster body parts on a truly transparent background. EXACTLY THREE columns and TWO rows, one separated part centered in each equal cell. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, diagram lines, shadows or background. Do not depict six complete characters.
Top-left cell: the complete LEFT-facing head + all long back hair + neck + torso + shorts, as ONE piece, ending cleanly at the shorts hem. REMOVE BOTH ARMS and BOTH LEGS below the shorts; reconstruct the torso/jacket beneath the arms. Preserve the entire facial drawing, bow and hair silhouette. Fixed true side profile facing LEFT.
Top-middle cell: ONE complete near arm, charcoal hoodie sleeve from shoulder to wrist plus small hand, relaxed mostly vertically downward with elbow bent slightly forward toward LEFT. Detached from body, no torso or hair.
Top-right cell: ONE matching far arm, same construction, slightly darker, detached, no body.
Bottom-left cell: ONE straight bare upper leg / thigh, vertically downward, matching pale skin, rounded hip attachment at top and rounded knee cap at bottom. No shorts, no lower leg, no shoe.
Bottom-middle cell: ONE straight lower leg, vertically downward, with bare knee and calf transitioning to the dark sock at bottom, rounded knee cap at top, ankle attachment at bottom. No upper leg or shoe.
Bottom-right cell: ONE isolated LEFT-facing sneaker in exact side profile, horizontal cream sole, brown/charcoal shoe with warm orange details, ankle opening at upper-right area. No leg attached.
Keep parts fully inside cells with transparent margins and clean antialiasing. Each part is to be independently pivoted at its natural joints for a proper 2D animation rig. Parts should retain rich original illustration detail and have sufficient overlap at hip/knee/ankle joints; do not draw joint markers.
